_source.title: Ponderacions Catalunya 2026
_source.subject: Tecnologia i Enginyeria — fase específica
_source.method: coordinate-based extraction of the official PDF (rotated/mirrored vertical headers on a 16pt x-grid; value cells bucketed by x-centre; degree names reconstructed from 5-digit centre-study code rows by nearest y-centre); public universities only (code first digit 1=UB,2=UAB,3=UPC,4=UPF,6=UdL,7=URV,8=UdG)
_source.note: Coefficients are official (0.10/0.20). Only degrees weighting this subject in the específica phase are listed; '-' cells are omitted. Values are provisional pending 1:1 name reconciliation for a minority of long double/campus degree names.
